title: Data Wrangling with SageMaker Data Wrangler [Hands-On] - Part 2

cues.en: Hello, my friends, welcome back to part 2 of this tutorial on data wrangling with Amazon SageMaker, and also, welcome back to Canvas.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎回到 Amazon SageMaker 資料整理教學的第二部分，也歡迎回到 Canvas。

cues.en: All right, so our first step will be to go to Data Wrangler, of course.
cues.zh: 第一步當然進入 Data Wrangler。

cues.en: The feature of Canvas that allows to do data wrangling.
cues.zh: 這是 Canvas 用來整理資料的功能。

cues.en: As you can see, the process goes this way.
cues.zh: 可以看到流程如下。

cues.en: First, you import the data, then you prepare the data, then you scale data operations, and then you build models, which we will see in further parts of this course, okay?
cues.zh: 先匯入資料，再準備資料、擴大資料操作規模，然後建立模型，後面會介紹建模。

cues.en: So here we go with the first step, import and prepare, the first two steps.
cues.zh: 先做前兩步，匯入與準備。

cues.en: And as I said, we're gonna do this on the same dataset as the one we use for AWS Glue DataBrew.
cues.zh: 如前所述，使用和 AWS Glue DataBrew 相同的資料集。

cues.en: And so, of course, since it's a CSV file, we're gonna click here, Tabular, okay?
cues.zh: 因為是 CSV，所以按 Tabular。

cues.en: These are just sample datasets with which you can play.
cues.zh: 這些只是可試用的範例資料集。

cues.en: They're a part of the Canvas dataset.
cues.zh: 是 Canvas 提供的資料集。

cues.en: And so to change this, of course, we're gonna do local upload, because our dataset is in our local machine.
cues.zh: 要換資料，當然選 Local upload，因為資料在本機。

cues.en: Of course, you can import it to S3 if you want, but let's do it the direct way.
cues.zh: 想的話可以先匯入 S3，但這裡直接上傳。

cues.en: So select files from your computer, then let's go to our AWS CMLE folder, then one data preparation for machine learning, and then, of course, data.csv.
cues.zh: Select files from your computer，進 AWS CMLE、第一個 Data Preparation for Machine Learning，當然選 Data.csv。

cues.en: We click Open.
cues.zh: 按 Open。

cues.en: Here we go, one file ready to import, we click Next, and it's gonna show us a preview, there you go, of the dataset.
cues.zh: 一個檔案可以匯入，按 Next，顯示資料集預覽。

cues.en: So same issue, the categorical variable, the missing values, if I scroll down, there you go.
cues.zh: 同樣問題，類別變數、缺失值，往下捲，在這裡。

cues.en: The missing value of the age here and the missing value of the salary and non-numerical values here, all right?
cues.zh: Age 缺失值、Salary 缺失值，以及這裡的非數字值。

cues.en: So let's click Import, it's importing, and then we'll be ready for the next step, prepare data.
cues.zh: 按 Import，正在匯入，接著準備資料。

cues.en: That was the first step, import data, and now, we're gonna proceed to step two, prepare data.
cues.zh: 第一步匯入完成，進入第二步，準備資料。

cues.en: All right, here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Welcome to Data Wrangler data flow in Amazon SageMaker Canvas.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到 Amazon SageMaker Canvas 的 Data Wrangler 資料流程。

cues.en: Okay, so first, know that you can know more about your data by getting some data insights, okay?
cues.zh: 首先，可以取得資料洞見，進一步了解資料。

cues.en: But that's not the purpose of this tutorial, so I'm gonna close this.
cues.zh: 但不是這堂重點，所以先關閉。

cues.en: And the first thing we're gonna do is click here, Plus, Add Transform.
cues.zh: 第一件事，按加號、Add transform。

cues.en: Okay, so as you can see, there is a new feature to explore, visualize and prepare your data using natural language.
cues.zh: 可以看到新功能，能用自然語言探索、視覺化與準備資料。

cues.en: Oh, that's interesting.
cues.zh: 喔，很有意思。

cues.en: I'm discovering this actually.
cues.zh: 我也是現在才發現。

cues.en: So let's close this once again and then let's click again, Plus, Add Transform.
cues.zh: 先關閉，再按加號、Add transform。

cues.en: And this is where you will see all the transformations you can do on your dataset.
cues.zh: 這裡會看到資料集可以套用的全部轉換。

cues.en: And so well, same as with AWS Glue DataBrew, let's do column by column, starting from the first column, country.
cues.zh: 和 DataBrew 一樣，逐欄處理，先從第一欄 Country。

cues.en: So here, remember what we have to do?
cues.zh: 記得要做什麼？

cues.en: We have to do one-hot encoding because there is no relational order between these three countries, and so let's go to the different transformations.
cues.zh: 獨熱編碼，因為三個國家沒有相對順序。看看不同轉換。

cues.en: Let's scroll down to see if we see one-hot encoding.
cues.zh: 往下捲，看是否有 One-hot encoding。

cues.en: No, we don't, and therefore, that's gonna be logically this one, Encode Categorical.
cues.zh: 沒有，所以合理推測是 Encode categorical。

cues.en: And as you can see, we can either do label encoding here or one-hot encoding, you know, with the vector representation.
cues.zh: 可以看到，可做標籤編碼，或以向量形式做獨熱編碼。

cues.en: So let's click this, then here, we're gonna select...
cues.zh: 點這裡，再選……

cues.en: There we go, one-hot encode, because that's exactly what we need to do for the country column.
cues.zh: One-hot encode，正是 Country 需要的。

cues.en: And here, we are, of course, going to select the country column.
cues.zh: 這裡當然選 Country 欄。

cues.en: Then we're gonna click out of it and we're just gonna do one more thing, we're gonna click Advanced here because we don't want the output style as a vector, but rather as three columns,
cues.zh: 點選外面，再做一件事，按 Advanced，因為輸出不想是向量，而是三個欄位，

cues.en: just like we had with AWS Glue DataBrew, okay?
cues.zh: 和 AWS Glue DataBrew 一樣。

cues.en: You can try vector if you want, but it will be a different representation, less intuitive than the columns.
cues.zh: 可以試向量，但表示方式不同，比欄位不直覺。

cues.en: All right, so let's see what we get.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: Let's click Add here, and processing your transform, and there we go.
cues.zh: 按 Add，正在處理轉換，好了。

cues.en: We now have the one-hot encoding of the country column, right?
cues.zh: Country 已做獨熱編碼。

cues.en: France is encoded as 100, then here we have Spain that is encoded as 001, and Germany that is encoded as 010, okay?
cues.zh: France 編為 100，Spain 為 001，Germany 為 010。

cues.en: So perfect, done for the country column.
cues.zh: 很好，Country 完成。

cues.en: All right, now, let's click again Plus, Add Transform, to take care of the missing values in both the age column and the salary column.
cues.zh: 再次按加號、Add transform，處理 Age 與 Salary 的缺失值。

cues.en: And you will see that this time we will do it for both at the same time.
cues.zh: 這次會同時處理兩欄。

cues.en: Okay, so let's scroll down, let's find missing data.
cues.zh: 往下找缺失資料。

cues.en: There we go, handle missing.
cues.zh: 就是 Handle missing。

cues.en: Impute, yes, column type, numeric, input column, that's where we're gonna choose at the same time, age and salary.
cues.zh: 選 Impute，Column type 選 Numeric，Input column 同時選 Age 與 Salary。

cues.en: Okay, let's click out of it, and inputting strategy, approximate median or mean.
cues.zh: 點外面，Imputing strategy 可選 Approximate median 或 Mean。

cues.en: Let's replace the missing value by the mean of all the values in the column.
cues.zh: 用各欄所有數值的平均，替換缺失值。

cues.en: That's a good inputting strategy.
cues.zh: 是不錯的補值策略。

cues.en: Of course, you can choose median, which is very good as well.
cues.zh: 也可選 Median，中位數也很好。

cues.en: And then let's check in advanced output column.
cues.zh: 檢查 Advanced 裡的輸出欄位。

cues.en: No, we're all good, we can click Add.
cues.zh: 沒問題，按 Add。

cues.en: Okay, processing your transform, and there we go.
cues.zh: 正在處理轉換，好了。

cues.en: Now, there is no missing value in the age column, neither in the salary column.
cues.zh: 現在 Age 與 Salary 都沒有缺失值。

cues.en: Okay, perfect, and finally, the purchased column that still has strings as values.
cues.zh: 很好，最後 Purchased 仍然是字串值。

cues.en: And so here we go, let's click Plus, Add Transform.
cues.zh: 按加號、Add transform。

cues.en: Let's click Encode Categorical, and, yes, this time is going to be original encode, right?
cues.zh: 按 Encode categorical，這次選 Ordinal encode。

cues.en: We don't need to do one-hot encode.
cues.zh: 不需要獨熱編碼。

cues.en: Input column, we scroll down, we select Purchased, we click out of it, Advanced, let's check.
cues.zh: Input column 往下選 Purchased，再點外面，檢查 Advanced。

cues.en: No, all good, we don't have anything else to do here, so we click Add, and perfect.
cues.zh: 沒問題，不需其他操作，按 Add，很好。

cues.en: Now, your purchase column has 0s and 1s.
cues.zh: 現在 Purchased 有 0、1。

cues.en: All right, so here we go, we are done data wrangling this dataset with Amazon SageMaker Canvas.
cues.zh: 好了，使用 Amazon SageMaker Canvas 整理資料集已完成。

cues.en: Remember to do the cleanup at the end of this section to clean up everything we did in SageMaker so that we don't get any charges.
cues.zh: 記得本節最後清理 SageMaker 的所有資源，避免持續產生費用。

cues.en: And now, look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial, which will be on SageMaker.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂實作見，仍會使用 SageMaker。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
